task.title: Downloading the latest build
task.shortdesc: Unless you have a copy on physical media, first download the latest build from . This topic explains the importance of extracting the files from the download before running the installer program.

step.cmd: If you do not already have a copy, download the latest software zip file from .
Extract (unzip) its contents to a local folder.

info.note: You must extract (unzip) the zip file to a local folder before starting the install, and use the unzipped files for the installation. Although Windows allows you to see the contents of a compressed zip file and even to launch an executable without extracting files, an attempt to install the software this way will fail.
